alternatives.reason: Anchoring the winch could help pull the rover across, but the tracks seem useful to put in place first.

reaction: The result was straightforward, though I’m curious how the winch will be used.
reason: Anchoring the winch is the only remaining combination and may help the rover cross.
expectation: I expect to secure the winch to the rock anchor, possibly allowing the rover to be pulled across the gravel crossing.

effect: The winch is anchored and aligned with the crossing, so both are ready to help the rover across.
reaction: The explanation of how the line steadies the rover while the panels spread its weight was useful.
reason: Combining the recovery line with the gravel crossing is the only available combination and should put both preparations to use.

effect: The rover reached firm rock with the cold case secured, completing the crossing and bringing the ice face within reach.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the tracks and winch work together, though the outcome was predictable.
